findings.title: Incomplete Translation Integration - Hardcoded English Strings Remain
findings.description: Multiple user-facing strings remain hardcoded in English despite translation keys existing or being required. Found instances: 'Review brief' (lines 1692, 1786), 'Stop speaking' (line 1725), 'Stop' (lines 1796, 1818), 'Microphone Check' (line 1814), 'Type instead' in title attributes (lines 1674, 1774), 'Enable spoken replies'/'Disable spoken replies' in title attributes (line 1670).
findings.userImpact: When a Telugu, Hindi, or Marathi user selects their language as reply language, these buttons and labels still display in English, breaking the immersion and creating confusion about whether the language selection is working. This directly violates requirement 8: 'No hardcoded English messages remain for multilingual scenarios.'
findings.evidence: grep search of CineGenDirector.tsx shows literal English strings at lines 1692 ('Review brief'), 1725 ('Stop speaking'), 1796 ('Stop'), 1818 ('Stop'). Translation file has t.buttonStop defined but it's not used at lines 1796/1818.
findings.requiredFix: 1. Add missing translation keys to /lib/voice/translations.ts: buttonReviewBrief, buttonStopSpeaking, micCheckTitle, titleEnableSpokenReplies, titleDisableSpokenReplies for all 10 languages. 2. Replace all hardcoded strings with translation references: lines 1692/1786 use {t.buttonReviewBrief}, line 1725 use {t.buttonStopSpeaking}, lines 1796/1818 use {t.buttonStop}, lines 1674/1774 use title={t.buttonTypeInstead}, line 1670 use {t.titleEnableSpokenReplies}/{t.titleDisableSpokenReplies}, line 1814 use {t.micCheckTitle}.

findings.title: Missing Translation Keys in translations.ts
findings.description: Translation file defines 30+ keys but is missing keys needed for complete UI coverage: buttonReviewBrief, buttonStopSpeaking, micCheckTitle, titleEnableSpokenReplies, titleDisableSpokenReplies, and potentially buttonInterrupt.
findings.userImpact: Cannot complete translation integration in CineGenDirector.tsx without these keys. If coder attempts to use t.buttonReviewBrief before adding the key, TypeScript will error.
findings.evidence: VoiceTranslations interface in translations.ts includes buttonEnable, buttonStop, buttonTalkNow, buttonTypeInstead, buttonUseVoice, buttonSend, buttonPreview, buttonStopPreview but NOT buttonReviewBrief or buttonStopSpeaking. CineGenDirector.tsx has 'Review brief' and 'Stop speaking' buttons that need these keys.
findings.requiredFix: Add the following keys to VoiceTranslations interface and all 10 language objects (en, te, hi, mr, ta, kn, ml, bn, gu, pa): buttonReviewBrief (e.g., Telugu: 'బ్రీఫ్ సమీక్షించండి'), buttonStopSpeaking (e.g., Telugu: 'మాట్లాడడం ఆపండి'), micCheckTitle (e.g., Telugu: 'మైక్రోఫోన్ తనిఖీ'), titleEnableSpokenReplies, titleDisableSpokenReplies.

findings.title: No Verification Evidence for TypeScript Compilation

Review instructions state: 'Read the recorded build/test evidence instead of rerunning suites.' No evidence was recorded.
findings.userImpact: Cannot confirm the code actually compiles without TypeScript errors. Given the incomplete translation integration (Blocker 1 & 2), attempting to use undefined translation keys like t.buttonReviewBrief would cause compilation errors. This blocks approval as required verification is missing.
findings.evidence: Verification.md line ~160 states 'Result: ✅ PASSED (Exit code 0, no errors)' but the 'Verification' section shows no actual npx tsc --noEmit command execution or output.
findings.requiredFix: After fixing Blockers 1 and 2, run 'cd /Users/shaisthashaik/Desktop/Cinegen/cinegen && npx tsc --noEmit' and record the actual terminal output in verification.md. Only approve if output shows zero TypeScript errors.
